method: Read 666–733, preserving separate lawsuits, pseudonyms and chronology. Add transferable reporting/policy language, explain linked fragments, and leave disputed room names and broken clauses unapproved.
phrases: one of the accused
one of the people alleged to have done something wrong
被指控者之一
The novel follows one of the accused as she tells her side of the story.
小说讲述了其中一名被指控者如何陈述自己的经历。
The accused is a noun phrase for accused people, not convicted people. Seems in the source and the next sentence's uncertainty prevent identification of the pseudonymous person.
versus
against, used between opposing parties' names in a case title
诉；对（用于案件双方名称之间）
The fictional case is listed as Lee versus Hill.
这个虚构案件列为“李诉希尔案”。
Often written v. in case titles. John Doe is the pseudonymous plaintiff in this separate suit against Cornell, not necessarily Jane Doe or an independently identified person.
the essence of
the central nature or main point of
……的核心；……的要点
The essence of the proposal is to reduce waiting times.
这个提案的核心是缩短等待时间。
Here the narrator summarizes the lawsuit's objection to the investigation conclusion. Essence is central argument, not proof that the objection is justified or a literal extract.
typo
an accidental typing or printing error
打字错误；排印错误
There's a typo in the meeting invitation.
会议邀请里有个打字错误。
Short for typographical error. The narrator's denial that a room name is a typo does not verify the name, especially before I don't know in 714–716.
incapacitated
unable to function or act normally because of one's condition
丧失正常行动或应对能力的
In the novel, the exhausted traveler is temporarily incapacitated.
小说中，那位筋疲力尽的旅人暂时失去了正常行动能力。
Source Jane says attributes the condition; not a fresh clinical diagnosis or a jurisdiction-specific legal capacity test. Stronger than simply tired or inconvenienced.
UTI
urinary tract infection
尿路感染（缩写）
The glossary expands UTI as urinary tract infection.
词汇表把 UTI 展开为“尿路感染”。
Read the letters U-T-I. The source reports medication taken out of fear; this card does not establish an infection, appropriate drug choice, prevention or effectiveness.
code of conduct
a set of rules about expected behavior within an organization
行为准则；行为规范
All volunteers receive a copy of the code of conduct.
所有志愿者都会收到一份行为准则。
Institutional rules, not computer code. Alleged violations means claimed breaches, not proven findings; suspension is temporary in the narrated response.
chunks: it's not until
直到……才……
Emphasize that an event does not occur before a specified time.
It is/was not until + time/clause + that + main clause; preserve tense consistently in teaching examples.

Source omits that and restarts the clause. Teaching examples use the complete construction, not a fabricated transcript correction. Later that day is tied to the narrated October 20 timeline, not today's date.
你直到晚上才发现手机落在朋友家里，向家人说明发现的时间。
evening
phone
It wasn't until
It wasn't until evening that I realized I'd left my phone behind.
直到晚上，我才意识到自己把手机落下了。
朋友问你什么时候才认出聚会上那位旧同学，你解释是听到声音以后。
voice
recognize
It wasn't until
It wasn't until she spoke that I recognized her.
直到她开口说话，我才认出她。
同事以为你早就知道截止日期，你解释自己直到读到邮件才了解。
email
deadline
It wasn't until
It wasn't until I read the email that I learned about the deadline.
直到读到那封邮件，我才知道截止日期。
segments: They resumes Matthew and Winston, the two remaining men in 665; which is believed to be qualifies the room identification as uncertain. President means the fraternity leader, not the university president. Language and pronoun linkage can be explained without authenticating the office name.
John Doe introduces a different pseudonymous litigant, not Jane Doe. It's John Doe also sues is a restart; preserve the exact broken syntax and do not infer a real identity from subsequent hints.

Accused-person role is now explicitly distinguished from guilt. Seems to be marks the narrator's tentative identification, reinforced by 671's cannot say with certainty; the lesson does not name the pseudonymous person.

Because begins an explanation resumed by the investigation and disagreement in 675–677, but the interrupted exchange does not securely finish the clause. Keep this boundary issue, not a standalone causal assertion.

Findings are the school's conclusions and the person disputes them. Chapter nine conflicts with repeated Title IX in adjacent discussion; preserve the transcript and do not silently correct the institutional term.

The exchange appears to connect dissatisfaction with suing Cornell, but interrupted they are trying to and the separate yes obscure the exact completed wording. Do not label the source as a clean sentence or infer multiple plaintiffs from they alone.

Versus now explains opposing parties in the title. Civil lawsuit is not criminal prosecution and as well introduces a separate suit; John Doe remains an unidentified pseudonymous plaintiff, not a guilty finding or a second name for Jane.

The exchange appears to compare the timing of John Doe's action with Jane Doe's later lawsuit, but prior to Jane Doe leaves the event noun unstated. Retain that ellipsis rather than certify a precise chronology or treat it as before her existence.

This year is relative to recording, with September 2026 discussed earlier, not automatically the execution year. And then until is an awkward temporal splice; the source does not support silently converting it to not until or confirming a filing date.
chunk:9:i don't know if they got

Starts with a claim about large outlets, interrupts it with I think naming ABC, then says I don't know whether they obtained the whole investigation. These certainty levels differ; the unfinished object of getting their hands on and record-access prediction are not filled in or verified.

Read directly into 705: the central objection to the investigation explains why extracts are included in the separate lawsuit. Hey we don't agree dramatizes the litigant's position, not a verified quote or the course's agreement; that are included is one passive relative clause across the boundary.

Completes snippets ... that are obviously included from 704. Included means reproduced or contained in the discussed filing; obviously is the narrator's certainty marker, not separate confirmation of every quoted record.

Pieced together is assembling scattered information, not physically repairing paper. Tried to cross is unfinished; 707 suggests cross-referencing but does not authorize inserting it into this quotation or certifying a complete clause.
Pence remains the printed room name. Later assuming president's room supplies a hypothesis, not an authenticated correction; no name is invented from perceived similarity.

The sentence explicitly frames president's room as the narrator's assumption and distinguishes fraternity president from other presidents. Upstairs is relative location. Understanding the hedge does not verify the preceding Pence name, which remains pending.
Next-to/adjacent identifies the spatial relation and smaller is comparative. Fofus remains an uncertain proper label questioned in following lines; do not substitute F office as established text.
Typo now has a clear transferable example. This sentence denies a typing error as the narrator's claim; it does not settle the actual room name, and 714–716 immediately express uncertainty.
F office is proposed under explicit uncertainty. Preserve the printed candidate without treating it as a verified expansion, spelling or actual office function.
Repeats uncertainty with the Fofus variant; repetition does not authenticate a proper name or resolve its relation to the proposed F office.

The size/storage-closet comparison and alcove meaning can be followed, but Phophis and phophis add another uncertain spelling amid several restarts. The desk/chairs in 717 do not establish the official room name or function.

The consequential inability term now has a contextual gloss distinct from merely tired. By this point locates Jane's reported condition after the described events; says keeps the condition attributed and does not supply an independent medical/legal assessment.

Sorority house is the women's organization's residence, not the fraternity house she is leaving. October 20 follows the narrated October 19 night; later that day is within that narrative, not today's date. No new timestamp or independently verified timeline is created.

Bruise is the mark described by the existing bruising card; butt area means buttocks. UTI is now expanded neutrally. Out of fear and as a preemptive measure describe the reported motive, not an infection diagnosis or endorsement of medication safety/effectiveness.

Not until now has complete teaching models: awareness begins only later that day. Starts becoming aware signals developing understanding; repeated all is speech repair and public knowledge concerns circulation of the account, not public proof of every allegation.

The institutional policy cluster now has support: local chapter, temporary restriction and alleged rule breaches. Instant means immediate; an instant is the edited article form, while source a instant remains unchanged. Alleged is not a final finding.
This name list continues in 734 on the next page. Julia Lopes differs from Jillio/Giglio forms earlier; preserve the printed names and do not identify a corrected spelling solely by list position.
